summary: Dated trees are openly available for birds (BirdTree) and vertebrates (VertLife), from which tip rates and genus richness could be computed, and TimeTree and Open Tree cover more taxa; no repository was found that supplies precomputed tip-rate or incipient-species tables per genus, and plant infraspecific counts sit in a WCVP file whose columns were not inspected.
next_step: Fix one clade (birds via BirdTree plus a genus assignment from the tree taxonomy), pre-register the tip-rate estimator and the age/sampling controls, and download the tree distribution (zip archives of 1K trees each).
obstacles_confirmed: Tip-rate estimators are biased by tree shape, sampling fraction, and taxonomic splitting.
